nodes.name: Webhook Trigger
nodes.notes:
Entry point. Called by the Flask server when a job starts.
Receives: job_id, paper_path, template_path, output_dir

nodes.name: Input File Validation
nodes.notes:
Validates that job_id, paper_path, and output_dir are present.
Safe early exit before any processing begins.

nodes.name: Stage A — Extract Document
nodes.notes:
Runs extract_document.py.
Outputs: extraction.json and Original_Research_Paper_Backup.docx
NEVER modifies the source document.

nodes.name: Stage B1 — Fetch Zotero Library
nodes.notes:
Fetches your Zotero library via the Web API.
Outputs: zotero_library.json
Credentials loaded from environment — never hardcoded.

nodes.name: Stage B2 — Verify References Online
nodes.notes:
Verifies each reference against Zotero, Crossref, and Semantic Scholar.
Outputs: verified_references.json
Unverifiable references are FLAGGED, never silently accepted.

nodes.name: Stage C+D — Map and Renumber Citations
nodes.notes:
Stages C & D combined.
Maps each [N] to its verified reference.
Renumbers by first appearance (IEEE rule).
Outputs: citation_map.json

nodes.name: Stage D+E — Format IEEE Citations
nodes.notes:
Applies ONLY citation-number renumbering to the document.
Writes the IEEE-formatted bibliography.
Outputs: IEEE_Formatted_Research_Paper.docx
NEVER changes any other text.

nodes.name: Stage F — Apply Journal Template
nodes.notes:
Copies page margins, column layout, and styles from the IEEE template.
If no template is provided, applies IEEE default margins.
Never reorders or rewrites document content.

nodes.name: Stage G — Validate Text Preservation
nodes.notes:
Compares original backup vs final document paragraph by paragraph.
Outputs: Text_Preservation_Report.txt
Fails loudly if any non-citation text change is detected.

nodes.name: Final Quality Checks
nodes.notes:
Final node: assembles the completion response.
Returns status, output file list, and a reminder to review unresolved citations.

nodes.name: Return Response
nodes.notes: Sends the final JSON response back to the caller (Flask server).

main.node: Stage C+D — Map and Renumber Citations
